notes.text: Semahot’s account naming Rabban Gamliel the Elder is parenthesized in the checked edition. Sanhedrin gives the incident under an unqualified Rabban Gamliel and says Shmuel spoke to spare someone else embarrassment.
Heilprin infers astronomical knowledge from Shmuel the Small’s fitness for intercalation and compares him to the later Shmuel Yarḥina’ah.
The checked Semahot prints בן עזריה (“ben Azarya”) parenthetically after ר״א. Heilprin’s suggestion of Elazar ben Arakh remains a conjecture.
The primary accounts name Shimon and Yishmael without the fuller titles and use “to the sword.” The full identifications and dating are Heilprin’s.
Derekh Eretz Zuta 9:25 names Abba Issi ben Yoḥanan in this chain. Heilprin’s wording here has Yosi.
